name: Harima
text: Harima (播磨町, Harima-chō) is a town located in Kako District, Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan. As of 1 May 2022, the town had an estimated population of 34,735 in 15410 households and a population density of 3800 persons per km2. The total area of the town is 9.13 square kilometres (3.53 sq mi).

depictions.name: Harima
depictions.text: Harima Province Harima (播磨) was a province of Japan which today comprises Hyōgo Prefecture's southwestern section. During the Sengoku period, it bordered Tanba to the north and Izumi Settsu to the east, and included the major city of Himeji, which served as its capital. In the 1580s, the Kakushiba ikki members Fujibayashi Naoe and Yasuke visited the province during their hunt for the Shinbakufu.
